idea-plugin.name: Import Trimmer
idea-plugin.description:
Remove Java imports when they become unused.

Import Trimmer watches open Java files and reacts only to imports that it has first observed in use. Imports that were already unused when observation began are left alone. It is a focused companion to your normal editing workflow, not a general Optimize Imports replacement.

Choose how cleanup happens

  • Ask before removing (default): review a native IDE notification before anything changes.
  • Remove automatically: apply the same validated cleanup without a prompt.
  • Only when requested: review eligible imports from Find Action with no unsolicited prompts or edits.
  • Dismissed and timed-out suggestions leave the file unchanged.

Designed for focused edits

  • Revalidates Java usage immediately before removal.
  • Removes only the selected import statements.
  • Preserves remaining import order, grouping, comments, and unrelated source text.
  • Defers cleanup when analysis is incomplete or the editor is in a sensitive state.
  • Provides project-level controls under Settings | Editor | Import Trimmer.
  • Runs locally without telemetry, remote analysis, or background network access.

This release supports Java source files in IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2.2. Kotlin source cleanup is not included.

action.description: Review historically used Java imports that are now unused
